notes: Read SKILL.md and references/comparison.md, local.md, parasite.md, programmatic.md in full. Mode router that plans non-single-article SEO pages: programmatic (template x dataset page systems), parasite (publishing on third-party platforms that links back to an owned site), comparison (vs/alternative pages), and local (GBP, NAP, citations, location pages), each with its own guardrail.

Writes deliverables and a handoff summary to memory/content/ on user confirmation (SKILL.md:50-54,89). SKILL.md:73 describes a gated batch index push `python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/connectors/indexpush.py" indexnow --file new-urls.txt --key $INDEXNOW_KEY` (dry-run by default, `--live` to submit, only after the thin/duplicate guardrail passes); the script does not ship with this skill, so it cannot run from this artifact. Rated medium because of that described use of an environment secret against live indexing services and because parasite mode steers off-site publishing that needs user judgment; acceptable because the push is opt-in and unavailable standalone and all publishing is done by the user.

Guardrails are explicit and non-deceptive: parasite mode screens every placement against Google's site-reputation-abuse policy and platform ToS and rules out 'deceptive placements, fake reviews, hidden links, manipulated upvotes' (parasite.md:17-18,78-83); comparison mode requires an honesty rule and sourced or `[needs source]` competitor claims with no fabricated figures (comparison.md:17,21,98); programmatic mode requires real per-row data, N-gram dedup, and noindex for low-value pages (programmatic.md:96,147-158). Users should still review parasite-mode plans against current platform rules. Non-shipping optional pointers: ../../../references/skill-contract.md, humanizer-slop.md, platforms/*.md, ../../../CONNECTORS.md, ../../../SECURITY.md, and sibling skills including ../geo-content-optimizer/references/medium-github-surfaces.md.
